meta.title: R&D TEST REQUEST
meta.subtitle: <Short name for this request, e.g. 'Fan Controller thermal margin'>
meta.creator: <Requesting team>

deviceUnderTest.label: Configuration
deviceUnderTest.value: <Firmware version, build options, mods, anything non-standard>

deviceUnderTest.label: Handling / disposition
deviceUnderTest.value: <Fragile? Return after test? OK to destroy?>

purpose.background: <Why are we testing? What prompted this — a design change, field issue, new requirement, open risk?>
objectives: <A question you want answered, e.g. 'Does X still meet Y after Z?'>

approach: <Broad strokes: how you're thinking about testing this. Stress vs. characterize? Compare against a baseline unit? Test to failure or to a limit? Keep it high level — the lab owns the detailed method.>

successCriteria.pass: <Overall: what result lets us move forward?>
successCriteria.fail: <Overall: what result means we need to change something?>
successCriteria.inconclusive: <Optional: what result means we need more data?>

constraints: <Limits not to exceed, safety notes, things the lab should NOT do, data you need back (raw files, photos)>
